prompt: The attached image is a 244x240 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden chick</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:244px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:white}
canvas{display:block;width:244px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfffdfd);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(244,240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-122/60,122/60,2,-2,.1,50);
ref.position.set(0,2.32,10);
ref.lookAt(0,2,0);

function group(parent,name,x=0,y=0,z=0){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  g.position.set(x,y,z);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const chick=group(scene,'golden-chick',.045,0,0);
const trunk=group(chick,'body');
const head=group(chick,'head',0,3.16,0);
const color=s=>new THREE.Color(s);
function smooth(a,b,x){
  const u=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);
  return u*u*(3-2*u);
}
const down=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:1});
function surface(parent,name,sample,rows=80,cols=112){
  const p=[],c=[],ix=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=rows;j++){
    for(let i=0;i<=cols;i++){
      const [x,y,z,tint]=sample(j/rows,2*Math.PI*i/cols);
      p.push(x,y,z);
      c.push(tint.r,tint.g,tint.b);
      if(i<cols && j<rows){
        const k=j*(cols+1)+i;
        ix.push(k,k+1,k+cols+1,k+1,k+cols+2,k+cols+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(c,3));
  geo.setIndex(ix);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,down);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
// Cross sections follow the round haunches up into the narrow crown.
const rings=[
 [-.58,.012,.012],[-.49,.74,.59],[-.25,1.19,.91],[.02,1.36,1.04],
 [.34,1.47,1.11],[.70,1.49,1.14],[1.10,1.44,1.10],
 [1.56,1.35,1.02],[2,1.25,.94],[2.40,1.12,.84],[2.72,.98,.76],
 [2.99,.80,.68],[3.16,.70,.63],[3.40,.62,.57],
 [3.70,.575,.54],[3.88,.51,.49],[4.02,.38,.37],[4.11,.19,.19],[4.14,.004,.004]
];
function radius(y,k){
  let i=0;
  while(i<rings.length-2 && y>rings[i+1][0]) i++;
  const a=rings[i],b=rings[i+1],prev=rings[Math.max(0,i-1)],next=rings[Math.min(rings.length-1,i+2)];
  const h=b[0]-a[0],t=(y-a[0])/h;
  return (1-t)*(1-t)*(1+2*t)*a[k]+t*t*(3-2*t)*b[k]+
    t*(1-t)*(1-t)*h*(b[k]-prev[k])/(b[0]-prev[0])-
    t*t*(1-t)*h*(next[k]-a[k])/(next[0]-a[0]);
}
const gold=color('#ffbd21'),cream=color('#ffe1a8'),crown=color('#ffe346'),lo=color('#ee981a');
function coat(parent,name,y0,y1,offset){
  surface(parent,name,(u,a)=>{
    const y=y0+(y1-y0)*u,s=Math.sin(a),f=Math.cos(a);
    const x=radius(y,1)*s,z=radius(y,2)*f+.035*smooth(2.8,3.8,y);
    const tint=gold.clone().lerp(lo,(1-smooth(-.1,.9,y))*.50);
    const bib=(1-smooth(.68,1.28,Math.abs(x)))*smooth(.05,.68,f)*
      (1-smooth(2.14,2.56,y+.18*x*x))*smooth(-.45,.55,y);
    tint.lerp(cream,bib*.95).lerp(crown,smooth(3.45,3.87,y)*.96);
    return [x,y-offset,z,tint];
  });
}
coat(trunk,'pear-shaped torso',-.58,3.16,0);
coat(head,'rounded crown',3.16,4.14,3.16);

function oval(parent,name,xyz,scale,tint,roughness=.9){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,32),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:tint,roughness}));
  m.name=name;
  m.position.set(...xyz);
  m.scale.set(...scale);
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const eye=group(head,side<0?'left eye':'right eye',side*.345,.49+(side>0?.055:0),.448);
  eye.rotation.y=side*.50;
  oval(eye,'golden eye surround',[0,0,0],[.115,.142,.066],0xe6b52a);
  oval(eye,'dark eye',[0,.008,.047],[.078,.098,.045],0x1c180f,.48);
}
const mouth=group(head,'beak',-.013,.318,.574);
const upper=oval(mouth,'upper bill',[0,.012,.035],[.206,.083,.172],0xffbb36);
upper.rotation.x=.12;
oval(mouth,'lower bill',[0,-.043,.060],[.165,.052,.123],0xea9b2d);

for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const left=side<0;
  const wing=group(chick,left?'left wing':'right wing',side*1.07,1.67,.43);
  const hand=group(wing,left?'left wingtip':'right wingtip');
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
    new THREE.Vector3(side*.01,-(left?.43:.23),.02),
    new THREE.Vector3(side*.14,-.15,.17),
    new THREE.Vector3(side*(left?.16:.35),.13,.34),
    new THREE.Vector3(side*(left?.13:.39),.46,.54),
    new THREE.Vector3(side*(left?.06:.37),.74,.72),
    new THREE.Vector3(side*(left?-.03:.40),left?.99:1.18,.82),
    new THREE.Vector3(side*(left?-.07:.43),left?1.15:1.31,.85)
  ]);
  const wingGold=color('#ffb51d'),tip=color('#694019'),tipTop=color('#452f1a');
  function wingSection(part,name,start,end){
    surface(part,name,(u,a)=>{
      const t=start+(end-start)*u,p=path.getPoint(t);
      const tangent=path.getTangent(t);
      const across=new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0);
      across.addScaledVector(tangent,-tangent.x).normalize();
      const front=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(across,tangent).normalize();
      const r=Math.pow(Math.max(.00001,Math.sin(Math.PI*t)),.57)*(.438-.19*t);
      const f=Math.cos(a);
      p.addScaledVector(across,r*Math.sin(a)).addScaledVector(front,r*.89*f);
      const shade=wingGold.clone().lerp(tip,smooth(.59,.77,t+.059*f))
        .lerp(tipTop,.65*smooth(.79,.96,t));
      return [p.x,p.y,p.z,shade];
    },38,64);
  }
  wingSection(wing,'lifted golden flipper',0,.67);
  wingSection(hand,'brown flipper end',.67,1);
}
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const foot=group(chick,side<0?'left foot':'right foot',side*.62,-.47,.25);
  oval(foot,'webbed foot',[0,0,.13],[.37,.13,.52],0xe7a037);
}

const floor=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(200,200),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xfffdfd}));
floor.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
floor.position.y=-.605;
scene.add(floor);
const shadeCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');
shadeCanvas.width=shadeCanvas.height=64;
const ctx=shadeCanvas.getContext('2d');
const grad=ctx.createRadialGradient(32,32,0,32,32,32);
grad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(120,111,118,.32)');
grad.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(146,140,147,.18)');
grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(170,166,176,0)');
ctx.fillStyle=grad;
ctx.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
const shadow=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(6,9),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:new THREE.CanvasTexture(shadeCanvas),transparent:true,depthWrite:false}));
shadow.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
shadow.position.y=-.60;
scene.add(shadow);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffaf0,0xffdfad,1.68));
function lamp(x,y,z,power,hue){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(hue,power);
  l.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(l);
}
lamp(-3,6,4,1.62,0xfff8de);
lamp(4,2,2,.58,0xfff3d7);
lamp(1,4,-5,1.12,0xffffff);
function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref)}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[chick],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
